_what: Every narration sentence maps to a span of script/essay.txt, the sources of record for this film.
thesis: Each Set can be held only as many times at once as its scarcest required Cent allows, so the structures the Council identified narrow from hundreds of possible holders to one, and every transfer can complete one Set and break another.
script_target: ~60 s; 108 words measures 59 s at 1.84 w/s, but nine spoken numbers will run longer
epoch_convention: See essay block [7]. All counts are the September 2026 catalogue, measured 2026-10-24; no holder counts are said.
